user.title: Warden
user.description:
Warden adds groups, fine-grained permissions and required two-factor authentication for Home Assistant users. After setup, configure it from the **Warden** panel in the sidebar.

The owner account is never restricted, so you can't lock yourself out.

no_mfa_module.title: Two-factor authentication can't be enforced
no_mfa_module.description:
Warden is set to require two-factor authentication, but no two-factor module is loaded, so users can't set one up. Warden won't restrict anyone until one is available.

Add a module (for example `totp`) under `auth_mfa_modules` in `configuration.yaml` and restart Home Assistant.
